app_fee.value: Each application pays a non-refundable $30 fee.
app_fee.quote: Individuals who make application for admission to Florida Atlantic University shall pay a non-refundable Application Fee of $30.00

fee_waiver.value: A fee waiver is possible only for applicants who document one based on economic need.
fee_waiver.quote: Provisions may be made to waive this fee for applicants who can document that they have received a fee waiver based on economic need

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: The minimum university TOEFL iBT score is 79.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum university requirement for TOEFL is 548 (Paper-Based Test) and 79 (Internet-Based Test)

ielts_min.value: The minimum university IELTS Academic band score is 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum university requirement for IELTS is a band score of 6.0

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India can waive the test if it is at least a bachelor's-level degree (60 credits or an associate degree or higher) taught fully in English.
english_waiver.quote: Completion of at least sixty (60) post-secondary credits or an associate degree or higher from a U.S. regionally accredited postsecondary institution or from a recognized post-secondary institution abroad with full curriculum of instruction in English

notes: Graduate College apply page: TOEFL 79 iBT, IELTS 6.0. Several program pages (physics, chemistry, math, Integrative Biology, neuroscience, engineering) also print 'TOEFL 4.5; IELTS 6.0; Duolingo 110', which conflicts with the 79 (not resolved; flagged). Chemistry sets its own IELTS 6.5. GRE is set by each program. Waiver of the test by Regulation 4.009 (e) is also possible for 30 credits with a C or higher, including ENC 1101 and 1102 or equivalent.
